verses.english: “Mendicants, a crow has ten bad qualities.

verses.pali: Dhaṁsī ca, pagabbho ca, tintiṇo ca, mahagghaso ca, luddo ca, akāruṇiko ca, dubbalo ca, oravitā ca, muṭṭhassati ca, necayiko ca—
verses.english: They’re rude and impudent, gluttonous and voracious, cruel and pitiless, weak and raucous, unmindful and acquisitive.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgato kāko.
verses.english: A crow possesses these ten bad qualities.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu.
verses.english: In the same way, a bad mendicant possesses these ten bad qualities.

verses.pali: Dhaṁsī ca, pagabbho ca, tintiṇo ca, mahagghaso ca, luddo ca, akāruṇiko ca, dubbalo ca, oravitā ca, muṭṭhassati ca, necayiko ca—
verses.english: They’re rude and impudent, gluttonous and voracious, cruel and pitiless, weak and raucous, unmindful and acquisitive.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhū”ti.
verses.english: A bad mendicant possesses these ten bad qualities.”
